call_points.text: FY27 revenue guidance revised to ₹2,600 Cr, with a small chance of crossing it.
₹50 Cr capex in FY27, mostly debottlenecking, supports about ₹3,200 Cr of capacity for FY28.
Order inflow was ₹734 Cr in Q1, up 87% QoQ, with exports at 93% of it.
Railway takes no fresh orders; the segment will be reviewed at year-end and its capacity moved to generators and motors.
Cash stands at ₹240 Cr; working capital will stay at current levels as customer advances and tax provisions lift current liabilities.
Management declined to discuss the fundraise before the board meeting on Friday.
Domestic demand is subdued at 10-12% growth, and management sees no meaningful hyperscaler AI demand in India.
Turkey subsidiary has EUR 3-3.5 million of orders to execute this year and no big pipeline for next year.
Planned capex of ₹50 crores annually for this year and next to debottleneck capacity.

operating_notes.text: Export and deemed exports order inflow constituted 79% of total order inflow for the year.
Order book for the manufacturing segment is ₹2,208 Cr, of which ₹1,929 Cr is generators and motors, ₹211 Cr railway, ₹22 Cr spares and aftermarket and ₹46 Cr Turkey.
Export and deemed exports are 57% of the order book excluding railway.
Service revenue is about 5-6% of overall sales, and generators need almost no service in their first 10 years.

timeline.summary: Mohib N. Khericha (Promoter) declared no encumbrance on 41,978,661 TD Power Systems equity shares as of March 31, 2026, per SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Saphire Finman Services LLP, as promoter, disclosed holding 41,978,661 shares (26.87%) of TD Power Systems Limited on March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances declared.
TD Power Systems Limited scheduled an analysts and investors call on May 15, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST to discuss Q4FY26 financial and operational performance.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹589.19 Cr (+69.2% YoY), net profit ₹72.19 Cr (+36.2% YoY).
TD Power Systems Limited’s **Bharat Rajwani** shared the Q4 & FY2026 earnings call recording link on May 15, 2026, at 11:30 AM (IST).
TD Power Systems reported an earnings conference call transcript for Q4 and FY26, guiding for FY27 revenue of over ₹2,400 Cr.

TD Power Systems' Q1FY27 call (12 Aug 2026) reported standalone revenue up 74% to ₹630 Cr and PAT up 81% to ₹85.3 Cr, with FY27 guidance revised to ₹2,600 Cr and capacity for ₹3,200 Cr planned for FY28.

watchlist.response: Outstanding creditors have been completely covered, and working capital needs are driven by rapid business scaling and inventory build-up.

Quarterly order inflow against ₹700 Cr per quarter
Board approval of the fundraise, to be taken up at a board meeting on Friday

watchlist.response: Payment terms are fixed with customers and cannot be altered significantly without losing business; funding needs may rise and the fundraise could not be discussed before Friday's board meeting.
watchlist.text: Trade receivables near ₹785 Cr against ₹240 Cr cash, and why a fundraise is needed despite that cash.

watchlist.response: Declined to quantify the drivers (pricing, cost cuts, exchange rates, utilisation) or commit to an increase; repeated the same answer to a follow-up.
watchlist.text: Whether margins can rise above the 18-19% band given higher logistics costs and export mix.

watchlist.response: Evasive: said the segment is very large but gave no market size, and deferred all detail to an August announcement.
watchlist.text: Size of the above-100 MW generator opportunity and when it adds revenue.

watchlist.response: Said it is approximate and the company will do more if the market allows, but gave no firm number.
watchlist.text: Whether the ₹3,200 Cr FY28 capacity is a ceiling.

watchlist.response: No refunds, as the company exports from India and is not the importer on record.
